messages:
Lena: quick idea: gateway should avoid retry storms when upstream CB opens. propose 'circuit-aware retry shaping' + optional short streaming tail buffer for resume.
Ravi: +1. constraints: per-tenant memory cap, TTL, single-use opaque tokens.
Lena: headers sketch:
```
X-RW-Proxy-Retry-Hint: no-retry|retryable
X-RW-Resume-Token: rtk-<hex>
X-RW-Resume-TTL: 3s
```
Ravi: behaviour: if CB=open -> set no-retry. if streaming && tail-buffering allowed -> send resume token in trailer and keep tail for TTL; else return 503/fallback.
SRE: ops: add metrics resume.tokens.issued, resume.evictions, retry_shaper.suppressed. runbook: disable if evictions spike >1% (5m).
infra-bot: feature-flag proxy_cb_shaping created (default: off).
UX: client handshake note: use If-Resume-Token: header for reconnect; token must be single-use and region-bound.
Lena: next steps: I'll draft RFC + seq diagram. volunteers: @Ravi for CB hook + token lifecycle, @SRE for alerts/runbook, infra for flag. sync Fri to review. :thumbsup:
